title: The Impact of Volatility Targeting
one_line: Across 60+ assets, volatility targeting raised Sharpe ratios mainly for equities and equity index futures (US stocks 0.40 → 0.48-0.51) and consistently reduced crash risk across nearly all assets.

findings.statement: US equities: Sharpe 0.40 → 0.48-0.51 with volatility scaling (10% target).
Sharpe improved only for equity index futures among futures; crash risk fell for nearly all.

why.pattern: Leverage effect in equities; volatility clustering lets you forecast risk.

reported_results.headline: Selective Sharpe gains, consistent crash-risk reduction.

tradable_edge: Supports the volatility sizing view for ES/NQ.
data_fit: ES 1-min Dec 2013 → Sep 2026, NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026 (2024+ protected in the backtest project).
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 2), not by the weekly pipeline.
